ceu: ✦ The sextile between Venus and Mars

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: If you have an agreement to make, put everything in writing.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, family and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Go to bed half an hour earlier than usual.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, money and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.
